payload.reason: The evidence provides specific statistical comparisons between personalised and non-personalised text messages regarding completion rates and time to completion.

claims.text: Those who received non-personalised text messages had a higher completion rate (66.0% for non-personalised late) compared to those who received personalised messages (50.0% for personalised early).
There was no significant difference in the time to completion between personalised and non-personalised text messages, although a slight difference was noted.
Statistical analysis suggests that recipients of non-personalised messages were more likely to complete the questionnaire than those who received personalised messages (adjusted OR 0.44, p=0.02).
